paragraphs: Chapter 1035
Episode 249. The First Deployment of the Plutonian (2)
End of May, 1804.
The Lafrarosa opening festival was reaching its climax. However, the fervor of the festival was hotter than at the beginning.
For the people, Tikan and Lafrarosa were now perceived as ‘the safest lands in the world’. Beyond just enjoying the festival, a significant number were preparing to move there.
The reconstruction project included building cities to accommodate these civilians. Numerous architects and members of the alliance were cultivating Lafrarosa under the direction of Luce.

Though it had only been six days, Lafrarosa was already taking the form of a new city. It was natural, given the combination of superhuman strength and magic, and the rich resources available to the construction gods' contractor.
“Brother Jin, at this rate, we might soon be able to create a transportation gateway linking the docks of Sword Emperor Grounds and Lafrarosa.”
Boras clinked his gemstone cup against Jin’s, announcing.
“Is that technology already being completed?”
“The technology was already complete before we arrived, thanks to Dr. Qwaul. We just needed to prepare it for commercial use.”
The meeting of Plutonians top engineer and the best engineer of the Human World, Boras and Qwaul, was advancing the alliance’s technology to a new level.
Soon, like in the past, everyone in the Human World would be able to use ‘transportation gateways’. It was a technology that had fully overcome the influence of the chaos particles left by Gliyak.
Of course, the only force benefiting from this was the Vamel Alliance. And now, the majority of the world's civilians supported the Vamel Alliance.
After Zipple lost all its territories to the Red Plutonian, its core forces disappeared into the Tower of Story, and Kinzelo was preparing to flee.
Since the Vamel Alliance had liberated the lands occupied by the Demon Realm and Red Plutonian, currently, over 70% of the world required the protection of the Vamel Alliance.
Therefore, the transportation gateway was essential. To evacuate civilians first, no matter where or what battle occurred.
“But, Brother Jin. Recently, while analyzing atmospheric components for phase-tracking space leaps, I’ve noticed that the chaos particle levels have been rising for about four days now.”
“Chaos particle levels are increasing?”
“Yes. Of course, this factor doesn’t affect our technology. But I just checked again, and the steadily rising levels suddenly spiked.”
Jin’s eyes narrowed. An increase in chaos particles meant someone was using a massive amount of chaos.
“Is Ganesto plotting something… No, that doesn’t make sense considering Valeria’s record tracking didn’t pick up anything.”
Currently, Valeria was focusing on tracking the movements of Ganesto and Zipple.

Ganesto had been laying low since their defeat in the Mitra Desert, and there was no record analysis from Zipple’s side. Even the infiltration attempts by the Nameless and the Seven-Colored Birds into the Tower of Story were fruitless.
The alliance concluded that this was because Zipple had enhanced their ‘history manipulation’ power. Otherwise, even Yona wouldn’t have failed to infiltrate.
“My lord, great lord!”
Jet found Jin and Vahn.
“Jet.”
“Just now, a guy claiming to be from Kinzelo sent a letter. Here it is.”
“A letter?”
As Jin received the letter, his companions naturally gathered around him.
(Dear and beloved Jin,
It’s been a while, Jin! Lafrarosa is beautiful as ever today. The sun is sparkling, everyone looks happy, and new buildings are being constructed every hour.
Yes, that’s right. Marjiella also sneaked in to enjoy a bit of the festival's fervor. Honestly, it's so interesting that the world now feels safe and beautiful…)
Marjiella's letter resembled Kasimir’s a lot. The first few pages were filled with useless flattery and praise, making Jin and his companions roll their eyes.
(…That’s right. Ah! Now I should get to the main point, shouldn’t I? First of all, we are in Kinzelo… well, unfortunately, can’t accept Jin’s mercy. Meaning, we can’t surrender.
Ha, but! That doesn’t mean we’re going to threaten Jin with swords or desperately fight to the end, throwing everything at the Vamel Alliance.

After all, Kinzelo has always been like a fool, helping Jin many times, right? Frankly, there were several occasions where our actions saved your life. Also, many times, our intervention helped you achieve your goals. You must admit that, Jin.)
That was true. Because of those facts, Jin had said he would deal with Kinzelo’s atrocious actions through a ‘trial’.

(And now, we in Kinzelo have decided to support Jin and the Vamel Alliance even more than before. It's kind of like unrequited love, but what can we do? The one who is lacking has to make the approach.)
“Eh, what's this? Are these Kinzelo guys saying they want to be under us?”
“Let's read more, Murakan.”

(You must be curious about the reason. Recently, we've had some turmoil of our own. After the leader met with the witch, many things changed… It's better to hear about this directly from the leader later. It's quite a shocking story.)
“A witch, and a shocking story…”
“Did Orgal meet his ex-girlfriend and beg or something?”
The Vamel Alliance was unaware that the witch had summoned Orgal through Masalrun's dream. The truth behind their meeting was a matter to be verified later.

(Anyway, we've decided to support Jin and the Vamel Alliance, while showing no mercy to other forces like Ganesto, the Sun God Religion, and Zipple. And today, as part of that, I'm going to tattle on the Sun God Religion. They are currently conspiring with Nirgand, one of the Black Sea's Five Kings, to threaten the world.)
At the mention of Nirgand’s name, Luna’s eyes filled with killing intent. As part of Chiron's expeditionary force, the Black Sea's Five Kings were an entity of deep hatred.
“Youngest, Nirgand was father’s next target.”
Luna shivered for a moment, recalling the previous kings of the Black Sea. Dealing with 'Su' had been relatively easy, thanks to Chiron's transcendence, but chasing Kial in the Black Sea was hellish.

“And the Black Sea Five Kings' territory is where even our expedition risked our lives daily. But the Sun God Religion has already made contact with Nirgand? They are not the kind of beings you can negotiate with. At least, not as far as I know.”
“That's my experience too. But I'm concerned about the information Boras just shared. The chaos particles are increasing. Let's read the rest first.”

(They probably approached the Black Sea quickly through the Sun God’s temple in subspace. Like the Sun God Religion members have special powers, I also possess a power unknown to Jin. I personally witnessed their meeting using this power.

Nirgand was wounded and fleeing from Ciron, and the Sun God Cult seemed to make him a tempting offer. Soon, Nirgand will start to leave the Black Sea. Like Gliyak, he will certainly threaten the Human World, and the Sun God Cult will benefit from the chaos.)
“So they want us to deal with this Nirgand guy and the Sun God Religion too. These guys are trying to use us to wipe their noses.”
As Murakan said this, Vahn spoke up for the first time.
“Brother Jin, if this information is true, my brothers and I will go and subdue Nirgand.”
“Vahn?”

“The increase in chaos particles that Boras mentioned is not a normal occurrence. Also, subduing Nirgand will allow our father to return to the mainland faster. Above all, I have a bad feeling. If we leave it be, something troublesome will happen.”
“But aren't you still recovering, Vahn?”
“So you think my brothers and I will get more injured trying to capture this Nirgand? The density of chaos is continually increasing. We must crush it before it becomes a bigger problem.”
Vahn's swift decision surprised his companions.
(Unfortunately, we are still in need of preparation and can’t immediately assist in subduing Nirgand. Instead, while the Vamel Alliance is dealing with Nirgand, we plan to keep Zipple busy.
Zipple currently possesses a power greater than you can imagine, Jin.
I hope my letter hasn't upset you too much. I, and we in Kinzelo, are truly sincere.
I’ll end the letter here. By the way, this letter was written using Pirobs’s dream ability, so you can just return it to the person who gave it to you. It can be read using dream ability.
I chose this method to avoid Jin getting angry and coming after us. Please understand.
With my usual respect, Marjiella Ibriliano.)
Jin immediately contacted Valeria. They needed to pause tracking Zipple and Ganesto and verify the contents of the letter first.
[I'll check the records related to the Sun God Cult.]
“Thanks for your hard work, Valeria. And Jet.”
“Yes, my lord!”

“Take this letter back to the one who brought it. Tell them we will contact them after reviewing it. However, tomorrow marks the end of the one-week surrender period we declared. So, for now, announce that Kinzelo has been defeated and disbanded, whether they decide to support us or not.”
“But, my lord. The last page of the letter already says that.”

(For your information, we plan to officially announce the defeat and disbandment of Kinzelo at 6 PM this evening. The beastmen we protected will be relocated to the Vamel Alliance's lands, so please welcome them warmly.
Of course, none of our members will be among them. They are just beastmen. Cute and fluffy.)
The letter ended like that.
And before even two hours had passed, the Vamel Alliance received a report from Valeria. According to the letter, Nirgand was using the power of the Sun God Religion to escape the Black Sea.
